entities.name: Samut
entities.description: A former planeswalker from Amonkhet, renowned warrior with speed magic, champion of Hazoret and spokesperson for Naktamun's living; she led dissent against the God-Pharaoh.

entities.name: Echoverse Samut
entities.description: In the Echoverse, Samut is the right hand of the frozen god Razaketh and the terror-wielding tyrant of Naktamun.

entities.name: Djeru
entities.description: Samut's childhood friend, a faithful initiate who later commands Hazoret's soldiers.

entities.name: Nakht
entities.description: Samut's childhood friend and blue mage who died in the desert, withered by horror.

entities.name: Hazoret
entities.description: The god of zeal whom Samut champions; once Nurturer of Hearts before the God-Pharaoh corrupted her.

entities.name: God-Pharaoh
entities.description: The ruler of Amonkhet whom Samut discovers to be the plane's destroyer.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The dragon whose use of the Immortal Sun trapped planeswalkers on Ravnica and who threatened Samut's home plane.

entities.name: Tah crop
entities.description: The initiate group that trains for the Trials of the Five Gods.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: A group of planeswalkers who rescue Samut and fight on Amonkhet and Ravnica.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A Gatewatch member who spotted Samut running through Naktamun.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A Gatewatch member who helped free Samut and disabled the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A Gatewatch member who shielded Samut and Djeru from Hazoret; later honored in a memorial.

entities.name: Hapatra
entities.description: A figure who witnessed the gods' deaths with Samut and Djeru.

entities.name: Rhonas
entities.description: A god of Amonkhet who died in the Hour of Devastation.

entities.name: Kefnet
entities.description: A god of Amonkhet who died in the Hour of Devastation.

entities.name: Oketra
entities.description: A god of Amonkhet who died in the Hour of Devastation.

entities.name: Scorpion God
entities.description: The being Samut saved Hazoret from when her spark ignited.

entities.name: Razaketh
entities.description: In the Echoverse, the frozen god who locked away the other gods and iced Amonkhet.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: The planeswalker whose chest held the Planar Bridge control mechanism, destroyed by Karn.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A member of the team that closed Bolas's Planar Bridge.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A member of the team that closed the Planar Bridge.

entities.name: Dack Fayden
entities.description: A planeswalker who distracted Tezzeret.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: The rogue planeswalker who brought Hazoret to Ravnica.

entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: The city of Amonkhet where Samut was born, sheltered behind the Hekma.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: Samut's home plane, ruled by the God-Pharaoh.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where Samut fought the Dreadhorde.

entities.name: Dreadhorde
entities.description: Bolas's undead army, including enemies and gods Samut once loved or revered.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The battle for Ravnica against Bolas.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: The artifact Bolas used to trap planeswalkers on Ravnica.

entities.name: Great Desparkening
entities.description: The event in which Samut lost her spark.

events.summary: Samut watches her friend Nakht wither and die in the desert.
events.quote: Samut watched one of her best friends die

events.summary: In a sealed chamber in Bontu's Monument Samut realizes the God-Pharaoh is the plane's destroyer.
events.quote: Samut realized the God-Pharaoh was not a savior, but the destroyer of the plane of Amonkhet.

events.summary: Samut denounces the God-Pharaoh and the trials, abandons Tah crop and is labeled a dissenter; Nissa spots her.
events.quote: She abandoned the trials and Tah crop, and was labeled a dissenter for what she said.

events.summary: Samut tries to convince Djeru not to enter the Trial of Zeal.
events.quote: She tried to convince him not to go to the final trial; the Trial of Zeal .

events.summary: Hazoret has Samut imprisoned in a sarcophagus alongside other dissenters.
events.quote: The god called for Samut to be imprisoned, and she was sealed inside a sarcophagus alongside other dissenters.

events.summary: The Gatewatch frees Samut from her sarcophagus.
events.quote: Chandra and Gideon opened her sarcophagus and helped her out.

events.summary: Samut fights beside Djeru in the arena.
events.quote: Samut ran to Djeru's side, and the two fought back to back, Samut's only goal being Djeru's survival.

events.summary: Samut tackles Djeru away from Hazoret's spear and Gideon shields them, denying Djeru his death.
events.quote: Gideon intervened at the same moment, protecting the pair of them from Hazoret with his invulnerability.

events.summary: The Revelation occurs and the Final Hours begin.
events.quote: Moments later, the Revelation occurred, and the Final Hours began.

events.summary: Samut, Djeru and Hapatra witness the deaths of Rhonas, Kefnet and Oketra.
events.quote: Together with Hapatra , they witnessed the death of Rhonas , Kefnet , and Oketra .

events.summary: Samut's spark ignites when she saves Hazoret from the Scorpion God.
events.quote: Samut's planeswalker's spark ignited when she saved Hazoret from the Scorpion God

events.summary: Samut is lured to Ravnica and trapped by Bolas's use of the Immortal Sun.
events.quote: Samut was lured to Ravnica by the Interplanar Beacon , and immediately became trapped there due to Bolas 's use of the Immortal Sun .

events.summary: Karn, Nixilis, Dack and Samut go through Bolas's Planar Bridge to Amonkhet to shut it from the other side.
events.quote: Karn , Ob Nixilis , Dack Fayden , and Samut volunteered to go through Bolas' Planar Bridge to Amonkhet and shut the portal down from the other side.

events.summary: The portal collapses and the wounded Tezzeret says he is glad they defeated him.
events.quote: The portal collapsed, and the wounded Tezzeret revealed that he was glad they defeated him

events.summary: Hazoret arrives with Sarkhan and gives them her spear; Samut promises to return to Amonkhet.
events.quote: At Sarkhan's request, Hazoret gave them her spear to aid them in their fight against Bolas.

events.summary: Samut remains on Ravnica after Chandra disables the Immortal Sun, helping the Gatewatch against Bolas.
events.quote: Samut was one of the few planeswalkers who chose to remain on Ravnica after Chandra disabled the Immortal Sun, helping the Gatewatch in their fight against Bolas.

events.summary: At Samut's behest Chandra and Jaya cremate the inactive Eternals.
events.quote: At her behest, Chandra and Jaya cremated the bodies of the now-inactive Eternals.

events.summary: Samut loses her spark in the Great Desparkening.
events.quote: She lost her spark in the Great Desparkening .

events.summary: Samut remains Hazoret's champion and becomes spokesperson for Naktamun's living during the rebuilding.
events.quote: In the time of rebuilding, Samut remained Hazoret's champion and became the de facto spokesperson for the living population of Naktamun .

relations.quote: As a child, she was best friends with Djeru and Nakht .
She is the current champion of Hazoret , Vizier of Naktamun , and spokesperson for the city's living.

relations.note: She denounced him as the destroyer.
relations.quote: Samut realized the God-Pharaoh was not a savior, but the destroyer of the plane of Amonkhet.

relations.note: He shielded Samut and Djeru from Hazoret.
relations.quote: Gideon intervened at the same moment, protecting the pair of them from Hazoret with his invulnerability.
But they feared his right hand, Samut, the tyrant of Naktamun, almost as much.

relations.note: She helped the Gatewatch in the fight against Bolas.
relations.quote: Samut was one of the few planeswalkers who chose to remain on Ravnica after Chandra disabled the Immortal Sun, helping the Gatewatch in their fight against Bolas.
